newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - US T-bond volatilIties soft in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - US T-bond volatilIties soft in dull trade.

text.p: Implied volatilities for U.S. Treasury bond options softened under the pressure of weekend time decay as underlying bond prices were modestly higher, dealers said.

With February employment report due out in a week, option selling was not aggressive, but there was little incentive to bid up today because volatilities were fairly rich going into the weekend after spike-ups earlier in the week, they said.
Implied volatility for CBOT April T-bond futures options lost about 0.2 point to around 9.9 percent by late trade, while June was little changed at 10.0 percent.
